lines.text: BARC窗口：压反射之后还要打开它
lines.zh: BARC窗口：压反射之后还要打开它
lines.en: BARC window: after suppressing reflection, it must be opened

lines.text: 膜厚n/k / 固化 / BARC Open / 刻蚀选择比
lines.zh: 膜厚n/k / 固化 / BARC Open / 刻蚀选择比
lines.en: Film thickness and n/k / cure / BARC Open / etch selectivity

lines.text: 从降低衬底反射到图形转移，BARC需要被精确打开
lines.zh: 从降低衬底反射到图形转移，BARC需要被精确打开
lines.en: From substrate-reflection reduction to pattern transfer, BARC must be precisely opened
Transfer pattern to the underlying layer
Transfer the pattern to the underlying layer

lines.text: BARC的光学、材料与刻蚀特性共同决定工艺窗口
lines.zh: BARC的光学、材料与刻蚀特性共同决定工艺窗口
lines.en: BARC optical, material and etching properties jointly determine the process window
BARC etch rate and selectivity to PR

lines.text: • 膜厚与n/k匹配降低衬底反射
lines.zh: • 膜厚与n/k匹配降低衬底反射
lines.en: • Match thickness and n/k to reduce substrate reflection

lines.text: • 兼顾后续刻蚀与显影窗口
lines.zh: • 兼顾后续刻蚀与显影窗口
lines.en: • Accommodate subsequent etching and development windows

lines.text: •充分固化提升化学与等离子
lines.zh: •充分固化提升化学与等离子
lines.en: • Adequate curing improves chemical and plasma

lines.zh: • 避免显影溶胀、起皮或残留
lines.en: • Avoid swelling, peeling or residue during development

lines.text: • 固化不足会影响刻蚀选择比
lines.zh: • 固化不足会影响刻蚀选择比

lines.text: • 膜厚与n/k均匀性影响成像
lines.zh: • 膜厚与n/k均匀性影响成像
lines.en: • Thickness and n/k uniformity affect imaging

lines.text: • 合适的刻蚀速率与选择比
lines.zh: • 合适的刻蚀速率与选择比

lines.en: • Reduce PR loss and CD bias

lines.text: • 为下层图形转移提供稳定窗口
lines.zh: • 为下层图形转移提供稳定窗口
lines.en: • Provide a stable window for underlying pattern transfer

lines.text: 更强的耐刻蚀有利于转移，但可能带来CD偏差
lines.zh: 更强的耐刻蚀有利于转移，但可能带来CD偏差
lines.en: Higher etch resistance helps transfer but may introduce CD bias

lines.text: BARC相关的典型缺陷会影响成像与转移精度
lines.zh: BARC相关的典型缺陷会影响成像与转移精度
lines.en: Typical BARC defects affect imaging and transfer accuracy
• Helps pattern transfer to the underlying layer
• Reduces the risk of BARC residue

lines.text: • 过强耐刻蚀会加重CD损失
lines.zh: • 过强耐刻蚀会加重CD损失
lines.en: • Excessive etch resistance aggravates CD loss

lines.zh: 开口过度 / 侧向刻蚀

lines.text: 多维量测验证BARC的成膜、光学与开口质量
lines.zh: 多维量测验证BARC的成膜、光学与开口质量
lines.en: Multiple measurements verify BARC film formation, optics and opening quality

lines.text: BARC的表现直接影响后续工艺窗口
lines.zh: BARC的表现直接影响后续工艺窗口
lines.en: BARC performance directly affects downstream process windows
• Account for loss during BARC etching

lines.text: • 通常通过氧等离子体灰化打开
lines.zh: • 通常通过氧等离子体灰化打开
• 需要控制固化与刻蚀选择比

lines.text: 不同类型的反射抑制层，打开方式与工艺考虑不同
lines.zh: 不同类型的反射抑制层，打开方式与工艺考虑不同
lines.en: Different reflection-suppression layers require different opening methods and process considerations

lines.text: •常通过氚基等离子体刻蚀打开
lines.zh: • 常通过氟基等离子体刻蚀打开
lines.en: • Often opened using fluorine-based plasma etching

lines.zh: • 化学稳定性高，显影不易去除
lines.en: • High chemical stability; not easily removed by development

lines.text: • 选绎比与下展材料相关
lines.zh: • 选择比与下层材料相关
lines.en: • Selectivity depends on the underlying material
Underlayer also serving as a hard mask

lines.text: •可能需要专门刻蚀工艺打开
lines.zh: •可能需要专门刻蚀工艺打开
lines.en: • May require a dedicated opening etch

lines.text: • 帮作为関蚀硬淹眼食別
lines.zh: • 常作为刻蚀硬掩膜使用
lines.en: • Often used as an etch hard mask

lines.text: •需综合考虑劍蚀造拜比与图形鼓移
lines.zh: • 需综合考虑刻蚀选择比与图形转移
lines.en: • Consider etch selectivity and pattern transfer together
